base_setup_commands: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git curl python3.11-venv
setup_runtime_commands: pip install pytest pytest-cov pytest-mock pytest-timeout pytest-xdist pytest-asyncio
runtime_smoke_command: python -c "from azure.ai.ml.entities._job.finetuning import AzureOpenAIFineTuningJob, CustomModelFineTuningJob; print('Import successful')"

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: The test dependencies are installed in the base environment. No additional test-only installation is needed.
runtime_profile.notes: The environment uses a Python 3.11 virtual environment at /opt/benchmark/venv. The azure-ai-ml package is installed from local source. Marshmallow version is pinned to <3.20 for compatibility with the project schema definitions.

notes: Environment configured for Azure SDK for Python finetuning module tests. The project uses pip as the package manager with a virtual environment. Key dependencies include azure-ai-ml (installed from local source), azure-devtools, and azure-sdk-tools for test utilities. Marshmallow is pinned to <3.20 to maintain compatibility with the project's schema definitions. The test runner (pytest) is verified to be reachable and can discover tests in tests/finetuning_job/unittests/.
